claim.statement: The GUV'NOR cleanroom verifier (emilia-rust-verifier / ep-cleanroom-verifier, Rust) was implemented from EMILIA specifications and the published conformance vectors without consulting EMILIA Protocol reference source (packages/verify, packages/python-verify, packages/go-verify, or equivalent). One-team JS/Python/Go ports were not used as implementation guides. God Terminal and Continuum integration call this binary as an external process; that wiring does not change the verifier's clean-room status. Conformance v2 clean-room verification complete as of public ecr-wg commit 676dfa1a685248949b42a617c75107e7c84af6c2 (tree rust/ep-cleanroom-verifier @ de4aaa3f202685436d1d03a405cbb48ccb5c5cc4).
